verdict.rationale: Rootly's own schedule docs cover rotations, layers, overrides, restrictions and previews, and its pricing page adds holidays, PTO, shadowing and mobile swaps and overrides. Round robin is documented only within escalation policies, not schedule construction, and no evidence addresses time-zone handling. Missing for 10: documented time-zone support in schedules, round-robin as a schedule rotation type, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can build on-call schedules with rotations, layers, time zones, and round-robin coverage that match how my teams actually work

citations.quote: Create, manage, and maintain on-call schedules in Rootly with rotations, layers, overrides, restrictions, and previews to keep coverage clear and predictable.
Rotations built in minutes, with holidays, PTO, and shadowing; Mobile shift swaps and overrides
Configure Rootly escalation policies with multi-step targets, time delays, and round robin
These schedules determine **who is on-call at any given time** and control the **rotation** of on-call duties across users or teams.
